digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, etc.)
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) currently exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from successful writes, causing agents to perform redundant store reads for verification.
A uniform kubectl-style confirmation message contract must be implemented: success outputs one line `<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>`, no-ops output `no change: <reason>`, and both exit 0.

Global output flags `--quiet`/`-q` (suppresses confirmation only) and `--output <mode>`/`-o <mode>` (promoted to top-level router extraction) must work uniformly across all in-scope verbs including positional-only `_REGISTRY` leaves.

Existing seam return contracts and consumers (e.g., `add_dependency` returning `dict | None` for REDIRECT records) must remain unchanged; confirmations derive from seam outcomes without altering consumed values.

The `link` REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical before and after the change on both write and no-op paths, including under `--quiet`, and constitute the sole stdout result for redirect invocations.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract with zero information loss; transition must preserve UNBLOCKED ids within its normalized line.
